title: From molecular dynamics to kinetic models: data-driven generalized collision operators in 1D3V plasmas
summary: We present a data-driven approach for constructing generalized collisional kinetic models for inhomogeneous plasmas in one-dimensional physical space and three-dimensional velocity space (1D-3V). The collision operator is directly learned from micro-scale molecular dynamics (MD) and accurately accounts for the unresolved particle interactions over a broad range of plasma conditions.
